background.value: "fond blanc" (white background) — same national identity-photo standard used for Burkina Faso passport applications (no separate visa-specific photo authority found)

clothing_restriction.value: Avoid white clothing ("ne portez pas d'habit blanc"), high necklines/turtlenecks and coats ("tenues qui ferment le cou (col monté)"), earrings ("pas de port de boucle d'oreilles"), neck jewelry ("parures au cou"), and lipstick ("pas de rouge à lèvres") — general Burkina Faso consular identity-photo guidance

glasses_policy.value: Corrective glasses/lenses not permitted ("pas de verres correcteurs")

ears_visibility.value: Hairstyles covering the ears should be avoided ("coiffures qui cachent les oreilles")

accessories.value: No rolled/bun hairstyles or metal hair accessories ("pas de colle roulé, ni de mentaux")

official_source_url.value: https://www.visaburkina.bf/en/home/ (official e-Visa portal — home page confirms 4-step application process but does not itself list photo specs)

clothing.en: Avoid white clothing, high necklines/turtlenecks, coats, earrings, neck jewelry, and lipstick.
clothing.ko: 흰색 의상, 목을 감싸는 하이넥이나 코트, 귀걸이, 목걸이 등 장신구, 립스틱 착용을 피해야 한다.
clothing.ja: 白い服、ハイネックやコート、イヤリング、ネックレスなどのアクセサリー、口紅の着用は避けること。

glasses.ko: 도수가 있는 안경이나 렌즈는 착용할 수 없다.
glasses.ja: 度付き眼鏡・コンタクトレンズの着用は認められない。

ears.en: Hairstyles that cover the ears should be avoided.
ears.ja: 耳を隠す髪型は避けること。

accessories.en: No rolled/bun hairstyles or metal hair accessories.
accessories.ko: 말아 올린 헤어스타일(번)이나 금속 헤어 액세서리는 금지된다.
accessories.ja: 巻き髪(お団子)や金属製のヘアアクセサリーは禁止される。
